parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set routing-options static route 0.0.0.0.explanation: 配置静态路由，指定默认路由的下一跳地址。

set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 192.168.10.1/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet nat [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family inet nat inside

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 filter in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 filter input route-map-policy1
set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 filter in.explanation: 配置接口的输入过滤器。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family inet address 2.2.2.1/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet nat [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family inet nat outside

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set security nat source pool NAT_POOL ad.template: set security nat source pool [parameter1] address [parameter2]/[parameter3]
set security nat source pool NAT_POOL ad.command: set security nat source pool NAT_POOL address 192.168.10.0/24

set security nat source rule-set NAT_RUL.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] from zone [parameter2]
set security nat source rule-set NAT_RUL.command: set security nat source rule-set NAT_RULES from zone trust
set security nat source rule-set NAT_RUL.explanation: 配置NAT源规则集的源区域。

set security nat source rule-set NAT_RUL.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] to zone [parameter2]
set security nat source rule-set NAT_RUL.command: set security nat source rule-set NAT_RULES to zone untrust
set security nat source rule-set NAT_RUL.explanation: 配置NAT源规则集的目标区域。

set security nat source rule-set NAT_RUL.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] rule [parameter2] match source-address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set security nat source rule-set NAT_RUL.command: set security nat source rule-set NAT_RULES rule 1 match source-address 192.168.10.0/24
set security nat source rule-set NAT_RUL.explanation: 配置NAT源规则集中的规则匹配条件。

set security nat source rule-set NAT_RUL.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] rule [parameter2] then source-nat pool [parameter3]
set security nat source rule-set NAT_RUL.command: set security nat source rule-set NAT_RULES rule 1 then source-nat pool NAT_POOL
set security nat source rule-set NAT_RUL.explanation: 配置NAT源规则集中的规则动作。

set firewall family inet filter route-ma.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] from source-address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set firewall family inet filter route-ma.command: set firewall family inet filter route-map-policy1 term 10 from source-address 0.0.0.0/0
set firewall family inet filter route-ma.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器的匹配条件。

set firewall family inet filter route-ma.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then routing-instance set-next-hop [parameter3]
set firewall family inet filter route-ma.command: set firewall family inet filter route-map-policy1 term 10 then routing-instance set-next-hop 1.1.1.100
set firewall family inet filter route-ma.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器的动作。

set protocols ospf area 0 interface ge-1.command: set protocols ospf area 0 interface ge-1/0/2
